hook.name: hook
hook.reason: Prudence rushes in weeping and immediately states that Toby is dying, establishing high emotional stakes right away.

narrative_tension.name: narrative_tension
narrative_tension.reason: Tension builds as the reason for the medical denial is revealed (no money/silver), culminating in Lady Juliana's resolute decision to act.

cliffhanger.name: cliffhanger
cliffhanger.reason: It successfully launches the rescue mission, though it feels more like a scene transition than an unresolved question.
cliffhanger.open_question: Can Lady Juliana save the dying boy with only her coltsfoot and ledger?

context_independence.name: context_independence
context_independence.reason: The immediate medical emergency and the cruelty of the local apothecary/doctor are clear, but Lady Juliana's background (burnt cottage, bandaged hands) lacks context.
context_independence.blind_summary: A frantic young girl named Prudence begs Lady Juliana to save her dying younger brother after local medical professionals refused to help them due to poverty. Lady Juliana resolves to take her herbal ledger and go help the boy.

confusions.issue: Why Lady Juliana's cottage is in ashes and her clinic is gone
Why Lady Juliana has bandaged hands

curiosity_gap.name: curiosity_gap
curiosity_gap.reason: The clip shows a complete mini-arc of deciding to help, leaving the actual outcome of the medical crisis unknown.
revealed: A sick child is denied medical help because of poverty
Lady Juliana steps up to help despite having lost her clinic
withheld: Whether they can reach the boy in time and if the herbal remedy will work

emotional_impact.name: emotional_impact
emotional_impact.reason: Prudence's desperation and the cruelty of the apothecary evoke sympathy, though it leans heavily on standard melodrama.

stakes.value: A seven-year-old boy's life is at risk while corrupt medical authorities refuse to treat the poor.

missing_context: Background of Lady Juliana's injuries and lost clinic
curiosity_revealed: A sick child is denied medical help because of poverty
Lady Juliana steps up to help despite having lost her clinic
curiosity_withheld: Whether they can reach the boy in time and if the herbal remedy will work
promo_dna.appeal: A compassionate lady defies corrupt elites to save a poor dying child.

soft_rejections.explanation: The clip resolves the immediate question of whether Lady Juliana will help, as she grabs her ledger and heads out.
